title: Pistachio Chocolate Chip Brownies
changes_from_base: Cocoa batter with chocolate chips and green pistachios through it and on top.
summary: Cocoa brownies with chocolate chips and chopped pistachios through the batter and on top.
equipment: 20 cm square metal baking tin, lined with baking paper
heatproof bowl and small pan (or a microwave)

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

ingredients.note: 60 g for the batter, 20 g for the top

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Heat the oven to 180 °C (160 °C fan) and grease and line the tin.

steps.title: Melt
steps.text: Warm the butter with the sugar in a pan until the butter has melted, then take off the heat and stir well.

steps.title: Cocoa
steps.text: Stir in the cocoa and salt, beat in the eggs one at a time and add the vanilla.

steps.title: Fold
steps.text: Stir in the flour and baking powder, then the chocolate chips and 60 g pistachios. Spread in the tin and sprinkle the remaining pistachios over.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 23-26 min, until the centre is just set and a skewer shows moist crumbs.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool fully in the tin before cutting into 16.

tips: Unsalted pistachios keep the salt in check.
Toast the pistachios lightly for more flavour.
Take them out while the centre is still soft.
safety: Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Store airtight at room temperature for up to 4 days, or freeze for up to 2 months.
